C1707.title: File Sharing to Unauthorized Domain Leads to Data Exposure Risk
C1707.summary: An organization configured Azure AD domain allowlists to restrict file sharing to authorized domains only. However, the security team discovered that some files were shared with unauthorized domains, potentially exposing sensitive data to external parties.
